spec.headline: Car quit on you? Check your roadside coverage

entries.caption:
Breakdowns don't wait for good weather. If your car quits on a cold, wet shoulder this winter, would your policy help get you moving? 🚗

Roadside assistance, sometimes called towing and labor coverage, is often an optional add-on to an auto policy. Depending on your policy, it can help with things like:
• Towing to a repair shop
• Jump-starts for a dead battery
• Flat tire changes
• Lockouts and fuel delivery

It usually has limits, such as a maximum tow distance or a cap per service call, and it's typically only there if it was added to your policy. Cold snaps are hard on batteries, so now is a good time to check whether you have it.

Want to know what your auto policy includes? Call (425) 419-0099 or email cody@lamensinsurance.com.

Coverage varies by policy, state and eligibility.

spec.headline: Life insurance through work? Know the limits

entries.caption:
Have life insurance through work? It's a great benefit, but it may not be the whole picture. 💡

Many employers offer group life insurance, often a flat amount or a multiple of your salary. It can be a helpful starting point. A few things to know:
• It's often tied to your job, so it may end or change if you leave, retire or are laid off
• The amount may be less than your family would actually need
• You usually have less control over it than over a policy you own

An individual policy is one you own directly, so it generally stays with you no matter where you work. Many people use both together.

This post is educational only. Want to talk through how much coverage makes sense for you? Call (425) 419-0099 or email cody@lamensinsurance.com.

Coverage, features and availability vary by policy, state and eligibility.
